reason: 该插件的核心用途是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供启动时自动更新流程：对比本地版本与 npm registry 标签并在每次启动后给出提醒，按配置可自动执行安装。其主要能力是自动化维护行为，属于中等风险类型，因为可触发全局安装并会进行网络请求，但默认模式仅通知，不默认执行安装。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 DeepSeek Harness 启动时自动检查是否有新版本，默认仅提醒更新，并可按配置在启动后自动执行安装命令，同时记录最近检查状态。
summaries.en: This plugin checks for DeepSeek Harness updates at startup, notifies when a newer version is available, and can optionally run a configured install command while tracking recent check history.

capabilities: startup update check against npm registry

reasons.code: README states the plugin checks the local dsh version against npm dist-tags at startup and runs only once.
README describes two modes, with notify-only default and optional install mode that runs `npm install -g {package}@{version}`.
README indicates check history is persisted to `~/.dsh/dsh-auto-update-state.json`.
package.json and tree show a dsh plugin entrypoint (`lib/index.js`) with bundle patch wiring for host/plugin integration.

capabilities: startup update check against npm registry
